t: Eleven Nations Sign a Landmark Pact to Protect the High Seas
x: After nine years of talks, a coalition of coastal states agrees to shared limits on fishing and deep-sea mining beyond national waters.
p: The agreement creates a network of protected zones covering nearly a third of international waters.|Negotiators described the final text as a compromise with phased timelines.|Enforcement remains the open question as satellite tracking becomes mandatory.

t: Inside the Race to Run Powerful AI Entirely on Your Phone
x: Smaller models and faster chips promise assistants that work offline and keep your data off the cloud.
p: Compact models are changing how phones handle translation, voice notes, and summaries.|Dedicated neural hardware makes local processing faster and more power-efficient.|Privacy remains a key draw since sensitive text stays on the device.
